candidate_evidence.title: A proper Euler magic matrix of order seven

frozen_claim.statement: Let P be any unsigned 7 by 7 permutation matrix having exactly one diagonal 1, exactly one antidiagonal 1, and no eigenvalue -1. Then P has cycle type 1+3+3. Let {s} be its singleton cycle and C1,C2 its 3-cycles. For arbitrary u,v in C1 and w,t in C2, let F_ab be the elementary skew matrix on the unordered edge {a,b}, put S_P=(I-P)(I+P)^(-1), S(x,y,z)=S_P+x F_su+y F_vw+z F_st, and Q(x,y,z)=(I-S)(I+S)^(-1). The origin is an isolated real common zero of D(Q)-1 and A(Q)-1 in this affine three-coordinate family. Consequently, no nonconstant real-continuous solution germ passes through the anchor, and no rational parametrization defined over R can map a real parameter value to the anchor while parametrizing nearby Euler points. This is only a local obstruction for the stated families; it does not exclude a rational algebraic component having the anchor as an isolated real point, and it does not resolve whether a proper Euler magic matrix of order seven exists.

target_evidence.prior_stored_original_statement: **精确命题：** 判定是否存在整数矩阵 \(M=(m_{ij})\in\mathbb Z^{7\times7}\) 和 \(\gamma>0\)，满足 $$ MM^{\mathsf T}=\gamma I_7,\qquad \sum_{i=1}^{7}m_{ii}^2=\gamma,\qquad \sum_{i=1}^{7}m_{i,8-i}^2=\gamma, $$ 并且 49 个平方 \(m_{ij}^2\) 两两不同。 **领域：** 丢番图几何；正交矩阵；平方数幻方。 **来源：** [Scott Duke Kominers，A proper Euler magic matrix of order 5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.19416)，第 5 节明确说明所有大于 5 的奇数阶仍开放，并具体讨论 \(n=7\)。 **已知边界：** 截至 2026-09-04，7 阶仍开放。3 阶 Euler magic matrix 在有理数上不存在；4 阶有 Euler 的 proper 例；5 阶已于 2026 年构造；8 阶也已有 proper 构造。对奇数阶 \(n>5\)，proper 存在性尚未解决，因此 7 是首个未决奇数阶。 **最小非平凡例：** 来源给出的 5 阶整数矩阵满足全部条件，是当前可用的最小奇数阶正例和 7 阶搜索的种子模型。 **最快反例测试：** 奇数阶情形可缩放为寻找 $$ Q\in SO(7,\mathbb Q),\qquad \sum Q_{ii}^2=\sum Q_{i,8-i}^2=1, $$ 且 \(|Q_{ij}|\) 两两不同。用 Cayley 参数化有理正交矩阵，再求两个二次方程；有理解清分母后立即给出整数证书。 **可能适合 AI 的原因：** 存在性证书只是一张可精确验算的矩阵；5 阶构造提供了镜像 Givens 旋转模板，可由符号代数、曲线有理点搜索和稀疏 seed 优化联合探索。 **与历史近似题的区别：** 历史中的 3 阶平方数幻方只要求行、列和对角线等和；本题额外要求原始矩阵满足严格正交关系 \(MM^{\mathsf T}=\gamma I\)，因此是更窄且不同的 7 阶存在性问题。
